description:
Advances: ancora.tasks

Severity: Medium (calibrated), with one High. Consolidated findings F11, F12, F30, F35, F36, F37, F50, F51, F52, plus the tracked F18 and F19. ancora is 1.0.0 on hex, so each of these is now a compatibility promise.

F18 (High, was tracked) — the --json payload changes SHAPE by failure path and carries no version key. The env payload (gate.ex:46-63) has no branch key and no guidance key; the branch payload (gate.ex:361-387) has no message key. Neither is a subset of the other, so a consumer reading report -> branch -> changed_files nil-derefs the first time origin/main is not fetched, which is this tool most common CI failure. Adding a version key and one builder is additive but it is an output-contract change on a published 1.0.0 and needs a matching ancora.tasks requirement pinning the payload the way finding_line_format pins the human lines. Treat as a 1.0.1 decision.
F19 (was tracked) — hexdocs publishes 50 modules against a two-function promise (Ancora.Parser.parse_file/2 and Ancora.DecisionParser.parse_file/2). Decide what the library API actually is, including whether Ancora.check/2 and Ancora.validate/2 join the commitment given validate/2 already has an external caller, and record it in README and the corpus rather than only in mix.exs.

F11 — spec.init and spec.decision.new bypass Output.gated/2 in violation of ancora.tasks.gated_emission_paths, and spec_decision_new_test.exs:35 PINS the violation with assert_raise Mix.Error. Route both through gated/2, change the test to the gated shape, and tag one of the two to gated_emission_paths.
F12 — cut the always-exit-0 clause from report_task_flags and let status_derived_report own the exit tiers; the two requirements currently contradict each other about whether spec.status can exit non-zero.
F30 — document in README.md and docs/migration.md that CI must pass --base explicitly and that default_base is a local-development convenience. The ship proved why: on a push event the workflow fell back to the repo default branch and compared the trunk against an orphan board branch.
F35 — document the --json extraction rule: the report is the LAST stdout line that parses as JSON, and the verdict follows it. Change the head-of-list extraction in the tests to last-parseable-line. Note --json emits plain text and zero JSON on the usage path (output.ex:203-211); the env tier was taught to emit JSON in 1.0.0 and usage was left behind, with nothing testing it.
F36 — add moduledocs to spec.review, spec.init and spec.decision.new, and an Options section to all eight tasks listing each flag, its argument and its default.
F37 — drop sanitize/1 from json_payload/1 and narrow the property test to assert the JSON line does not match the verdict grammar, which is the property that matters.
F50 — drop the unconditional info-hidden suffix from the finding_line_format grammar and say which of the three counts are totals.
F51 — define --since and its precedence over --base in next_labels_verbatim, or reject the combination as a usage error.
F52 — add spec.review --root and --spec-dir and the three tasks short aliases to report_task_flags. Making aliases consistent across all eight is a flag-surface change and is deliberately NOT taken here.

Deliberately dropped by the review, do not relitigate: --debug is accepted by spec.check and spec.validate and does nothing. A specified no-op boolean on a dev CLI harms nobody, and removing an accepted flag is a break that would also need the requirement amended.
title: Make the CLI and JSON contracts match what the tasks actually do
